ValidationRule.description: R-PM11: submitted entries change only by the project owner or Projects Admin, approved ones only by Projects Admin.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISNEW()), OR(AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Approved"), NOT($Permission.Projects_Manage), OR(ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISCHANGED(Amount__c), ISCHANGED(Date__c), ISCHANGED(User__c), ISCHANGED(Category__c), ISCHANGED(Billable__c))), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Submitted"), Project__r.OwnerId <> $User.Id, NOT($Permission.Projects_Manage), OR(ISCHANGED(Amount__c), ISCHANGED(Date__c), ISCHANGED(User__c), ISCHANGED(Category__c), ISCHANGED(Billable__c)))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: These expenses are locked: recall submitted expenses to change them, or ask a Projects admin to change approved expenses.
